**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.25 (45k tokens, estimate)

Model: session model (general-purpose review agent). No escalation. Gate route: pr-test.yml run 43645794944 (macOS runner), quick gate and clippy green.

The lane lost the completion note of the review agent; the cost is an estimate from comparable reviews.

Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.

Rework pushed.
- The six source files have LF line endings again. The diff against main is now 63 added and 12 removed lines in 7 files.
- The branch has a clean merge of main. No conflict needed a hand edit.
- Tests: the one_wcs, setup_settings_page and structural tests pass (22 tests). Clippy on camcraft-ui and camcraft-app is clean.
- The before and after screenshots are still owed. No agent can start the GUI. The PR stays a draft until they are in the description.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 82fd8d7688cb506f78a454e0fd65a3d74f746eb2 -->

Needs changes before merge.

## What looks good

- The line-ending fix is confirmed. All six changed source files store LF. The diff against main is 7 files, +63/-12. No file shows a whole-file rewrite.
- The branch holds a clean merge of current main (`0db66c44e`). The diff against main shows only this PR's own 7 files. Nothing from main was dropped.
- The move is as issue #1648 asked. The Setup page no longer draws the work offset picker (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_settings_page.rs:87-90`). The WCS page draws it in its own group "Work offset (G54-G59)" (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:148-151`). The Setup page group takes the title "Set WCS from features", which now matches its one row.
- The control keeps its undoable command. `setup_wcs_pick.rs` is unchanged in this PR. It queues `CommandKind::SetSetupWorkOffset` through `state.pending` (line 89). Nothing writes the world from the panel. The layering holds: the diff adds no `sys_*` or world-level call.
- The structural tests pin the move on both pages, and no snapshot PNG changed. The new test `one_wcs::the_work_offset_control_is_on_the_wcs_page_and_not_the_setup_page` counts the combo (role `ComboBox`, value "Work offset 1 (G54)"): 0 on the Setup page, 1 on the WCS page. A second assertion pins the group under the origin group. `structural.rs` now reads 0 work-offset combos on the Settings page.
- `docs/decisions/1648-wcs-page-work-offset.md` follows the format in `docs/decisions/README.md`: decided, why, considered and dropped, cost.
- The PR body is complete: what changed, the pinning tests, what was not exercised, a `Changelog:` line, and `Fixes #1648`.

## Results

Built on the self-hosted runner (macOS): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43652049800

- Trial merge with main `0db66c44e`: clean.
- Quick gate: pass. The ui suites ran 60 s, 0 failed. This includes the changed `one_wcs`, `setup_settings_page` and `structural` tests.
- Clippy on `camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not built locally: the diff adds no Windows-only readings, so the runner's arms cover it.
- This run replaces the green run `43645794944` on the old head `bacbfc3ef`. That run did not count for this head.

## Requested before merge

The code passes review. This PR owes one thing: a before/after screenshot pair in the body.

1. Add the before and after screenshots to the PR body. This PR changes a UI page, so rule #1209 needs the pair in the description. The body states "no screenshot exists" under Not exercised. Show the Setup page and the WCS page before the change, and both pages after it. This fix is a body edit. No push to the branch is needed for it.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The earlier note stands. The picker still draws its row label `"    Work offset"` with a leading indent (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_wcs_pick.rs:73`). Inside its own titled group the label repeats the title. A later issue can drop it.
- `pages.rs` is now 1,232 lines. Main has 1,230. Files already over the 400-line mark are a note, not a blocker.
- Commit `150e6201c` uses the type `style`. AGENTS.md lists `feat`, `fix`, `perf`, `refactor`, `test`, `docs`, `build`, `ci` and `chore`. `chore` would fit better. The PR subject is correct, so this does not block.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 82fd8d7688cb506f78a454e0fd65a3d74f746eb2 -->

**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.48 (86k tokens, estimate)

Model: session model (general-purpose review agent). Route: pr-test.yml run + diff read (re-review of the rework head).

Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.

Fix pass on review of head 82fd8d768.

The review has one blocking item: before and after screenshots in the PR body.

- This item needs the real app to render both pages. The rules for this session forbid launching the app. The agent did not make the screenshots.
- No code change is needed. The review found no code defect. The agent pushed nothing, ran no gate, and did not change the draft state or the labels.
- A person with a GUI session must add the screenshot pair (Setup page and WCS page, before and after) to the PR body.
The PR body now has the before and after screenshots of the WCS page. Ready for a re-check.

This PR goes back to draft. The review of head `82fd8d768` has the label `needs-rework`. A rework agent now adds the Setup page screenshots and fixes the row label. The PR gets no push while it is ready, so it is a draft first.

Rework of the review of head `82fd8d768`. The new head is `d24d404b0`.

- Blocker 1 (screenshots): done. The PR body now has four images: the Setup page and the WCS page, before and after. They are on the `screenshots` branch (commit `e8608eec7`). The harness render of the shipping shell made them. No snapshot PNG changed.
- Note (indented "    Work offset" label): fixed in `d24d404b0`. The label is now "Work offset". `one_wcs::the_work_offset_control_is_on_the_wcs_page_and_not_the_setup_page` pins one plain label and no indented label on the WCS page. The `OFFSET` constant of `setup_settings_page.rs` follows.
- Note (`pages.rs` at 1,232 lines): not changed. The file was over the limit on main before this PR. A split is outside the scope of this PR.
- Note (commit type `style` on `150e6201c`): not changed. A fix needs a history rewrite and a force-push, and AGENTS.md forbids a force-push. The PR subject uses `feat`.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` is green (ui lib 778 passed; boundary, boundary_picks, sinker_setup, theme_files pass). Clippy on `camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` is clean.

The change does not touch posted G-code, a collision or gouge check, simulation or geometry. The PR stays a draft. The review labels stay for the reviewer.

Addressed: the latest review's screenshot request is already satisfied in the PR body. I verified all four linked images: Setup and WCS pages, before and after. The images load and show the requested changes. No screenshot or review evidence was added to the PR branch.

The earlier LF finding is also satisfied. All seven changed Rust files contain zero CRLF line endings. The existing plain-label fix is pinned by `one_wcs::the_work_offset_control_is_on_the_wcs_page_and_not_the_setup_page`; that test passed.

Current head is unchanged: `d24d404b04b70233a92759c4f57f2c8f6b38f42f`. No new code fix, mutation check, commit, or push was needed. No current-head review contains another requested change.

Validation on this head: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed (802 passed, 5 ignored, 0 failed). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed. The PR is mergeable. Labels and readiness were left unchanged.

Please re-review this head and the screenshot evidence in the description.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d24d404b04b70233a92759c4f57f2c8f6b38f42f -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

I checked the three earlier blockers on the current head. All three are fixed.

What looks good:
- Screenshots: the PR body has four before/after images (Setup page and WCS page). All four links return a PNG.
- Line endings: the PR diff has no CR bytes. The CRLF commit is reverted.
- Label: the row label is `Work offset` with no indent. `one_wcs` pins this.
- The work offset picker keeps `SetSetupWorkOffset` and `setup::wcs_slot`. The diff adds no second derivation of G54-G59, so undo and redo do not change.
- No snapshot PNG changed. The structural tests carry the change.
- The `docs/decisions/1648-wcs-page-work-offset.md` entry gives the choice, the reason and the dropped options.
- The body has `Changelog:`, `Effort:` and `Fixes #N`. The PR touches no process file.

Results, merged with `origin/main` (`fac6c8e8d`), run locally with `-j 6`:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (egui_app::tests, includes `one_wcs`, `setup_settings_page`, `structural`) | 463 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (all) | 985 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one failure is `egui_app::rest_pocket_tests::rest_group_warns_and_refuses_incompatible_strategy_and_predrilled_on_apply` (`Zigzag draft refusal`, `rest_pocket_tests.rs:280`). The PR does not touch rest pocket code or this test. I did not run the test on a clean `main`, so I cannot say if main is red. I do not count it against this PR. The maintainer can decide.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking):
1. The group title `Work offset (G54-G59)` (`wcs_page.rs:32`) names G-code words. The combo text already does this (`Work offset 1 (G54)`, #931). Plain wording such as `Work offset` could come in a follow-up.
2. I did not run the GUI. The screenshots come from the kittest harness, as the body says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** not known. The token totals of the worker and of the earlier review runs are not available to this review. Main-session coordination is not counted.
Effort: medium
